title: Web API
html:
For the complete documentation index, see llms.txt. Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending .md to page URLs; this page is available as Markdown.

Web API

AdaptixC2 Server exposes a REST API for managing the teamserver. The API runs over HTTPS and uses JSON for data transfer.

Base URL: https://{host}:{port}{endpoint}

  • {host} — server IP address or domain
  • {port} — teamserver port
  • {endpoint} — base path defined in the profile configuration

Info

If authentication fails, the web server will respond with a 404 page by default.

Authentication

The API uses JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for authentication. To obtain tokens, log in via /login.

POST /login Authenticate a user and obtain JWT tokens. *** **Request Body:** 
{
  "username": "string",
  "password": "string",
  "version": "string"
}
| Field | Type | Required | Description | | ------------ | ------ | -------- | ----------------- | | **username** | string | Yes | Operator name | | **password** | string | Yes | Operator password | | **version** | string | No | Client version | *** **Response (200 OK):** 
{
  "access_token": "string",
  "refresh_token": "string",
  "version": "v2.0"
}
**Errors:** * Invalid credentials — returns 404 (configurable error page)
POST /refresh Refresh the access token using the refresh token. *** **Request** Send the refresh token in the header: 
Authorization: Bearer <refresh_token>
*** **Response (200 OK):** 
{
  "access_token": "string"
}

OTP

OTP (One-Time Password) — one-time tokens with a short TTL (60 sec). Used for:

  • Secure file transfers (upload/download)
  • Establishing WebSocket connections (/connect)
  • Creating WebSocket channels (/channel)

Every OTP route reads the token from the query parameter ?otp=.

  • TTL: OTP token is valid for 60 seconds after generation
  • One-time use: Each token can be used only once
  • Type isolation: A connect token cannot be used on /channel and vice versa
  • Security: The token contains no data — just a random 256-bit identifier
POST /otp/generate Generate a one-time token. Requires an Access Token. *** **Request (JSON)** Universal request format: 
{
  "type": "string",
  "data": { ... }
}
FieldTypeRequiredDescription
typestringYesOTP type (see below)
dataobjectDepends on typeType-specific JSON data
*** **Response (200 OK):** 
{
  "ok": true,
  "message": "<otp_token>"
}
**Response (error):** 
{
  "ok": false,
  "message": "error description"
}
connect Client WebSocket connection 
{
  "type": "connect",
  "data": {
    "client_type": 1,
    "console_team_mode": false,
    "subscriptions": ["agents", "listeners"]
  }
}
data fieldTypeDefaultDescription
client_typeuint81 (UI)Client type: 1=UI, 2=WEB, 3=CLI
console_team_modeboolfalseTeam-console mode
subscriptionsstring[][]Subscription categories
channel_tunnel WebSocket channel for a tunnel 
{
  "type": "channel_tunnel",
  "data": {
    "tunnel_id": 1,
    "channel_id": 2,
    "mode": "tcp|udp",
    "host": "string",
    "port": "string"
  }
}
data fieldTypeRequiredDescription
tunnel_idint64YesTunnel ID
channel_idint64YesChannel ID
modestringFor SOCKS5Mode: tcp or udp
hoststringFor SOCKSTarget host
portstringFor SOCKSTarget port (1-65535)
channel_terminal WebSocket channel for a terminal 
{
  "type": "channel_terminal",
  "data": {
    "agent_id": 1,
    "terminal_id": 1,
    "program": "string",
    "size_h": 24,
    "size_w": 80,
    "oem_cp": 65001
  }
}
data fieldTypeRequiredDescription
agent_idint64YesAgent ID
terminal_idint64YesTerminal ID
programstringYesProgram to run
size_hintYesTerminal height (rows)
size_wintYesTerminal width (columns)
oem_cpintYesOEM Code Page
channel_agent_build WebSocket channel for agent build 
{
  "type": "channel_agent_build",
  "data": {
    "agent_name": "string",
    "listeners_name": ["listener1", "listener2"]
  }
}
data fieldTypeRequiredDescription
agent_namestringYesAgent name to build
listeners_namestring[]YesList of listener names
download File download 
{
  "type": "download",
  "data": {
    "id": 1
  }
}
data fieldTypeDescription
idint64File id of a finished download
tmp_upload Temporary file upload 
{
  "type": "tmp_upload",
  "data": {
    "id": 1
  }
}
data fieldTypeDescription
idint64Id of a temporary upload already registered on the server

Full channel creation flow example (tunnel)

  1. Make sure the client is connected via /connect
  2. POST /otp/generate (Authorization: Bearer <access_token>) Body: {"type": "channel_tunnel", "data": {"tunnel_id": "...", "channel_id": "...", ...}} → obtain otp_token
  3. GET /channel?otp=<otp_token> → WebSocket upgrade
POST /otp/upload/temp?otp= Upload bytes into a temporary upload that was already registered. The token type must be `tmp_upload`, and its `id` must still be in the server's temporary-upload map. *** **Request** `multipart/form-data`
FieldTypeDescription
filefileThe file
*** **Response (200 OK):** an empty body. A wrong token type, an unknown id, a missing `file` field, or a save error is a `404` text body with the error string. A bad or expired token is rejected by the OTP middleware before this handler runs.
GET /otp/download/sync?otp= Download a finished file. The token type must be `download`. The server returns the file only when that download's state is finished. *** **Response (200 OK)** the file bytes, with: * `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=""` * `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` * `Content-Length: ` The filename is the base name of the stored path, not a separate display name. If the id is unknown or the download is not finished, the response is `404` with a text error (`File not found: …` or `Download not finished`).

Client Management

POST /sync Asks the server to push the current state to this operator's already open WebSocket. The handler does not read the body. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` *** **Response (200 OK):** 
{
  "ok": true,
  "message": "sync started"
}
POST /subscribe Subscribe the client to event categories. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` 
{
  "categories": ["string"],
  "console_team_mode": true|false
}
FieldTypeRequiredDescription
categoriesstring[]YesList of categories to subscribe to
console_team_modebooleanNoTeam-console mode
*** **Response (200 OK):** 
{
  "ok": true,
  "message": "subscribe started"
}
GET /connect?otp= Establish a WebSocket connection for real-time updates. Requires an OTP token of type `connect`. *** **Response:** WebSocket upgrade All connection parameters (client\_type, subscriptions, etc.) are passed when generating the OTP, not when connecting.
GET /channel?otp= Create a WebSocket channel. The token type must start with `channel_` (`channel_tunnel`, `channel_terminal`, or `channel_agent_build`). A token whose type is exactly `channel` is rejected. *** **Response:** WebSocket upgrade The channel type and initialization data are passed when generating the OTP, not when connecting.

Listener

GET /listener/list Get the list of all listeners. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` *** **Response (200 OK):** JSON array of `ListenerData`. An empty server returns `null`, not `[]`, because the handler marshals a nil slice. 
[
  {
    "l_name": "http-443",
    "l_reg_name": "BeaconHTTP",
    "l_protocol": "http",
    "l_type": "external",
    "l_bind_host": "0.0.0.0",
    "l_bind_port": "443",
    "l_agent_addr": "10.0.0.5:443",
    "a_create_time": 1718500000,
    "l_status": "Listen",
    "l_tags": "prod",
    "l_data": "{\"host_bind\":\"0.0.0.0\",\"port_bind\":\"443\"}",
    "l_watermark": "c04c4e57"
  }
]

GET /agent/generate Generate an agent payload. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` 
{
  "agent": "string",
  "listener_name": ["string"],
  "config": "string",
  "save_to_store": true,
  "description": "string"
}
FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agentstringYesAgent type name
listener_namestring[]YesList of listener names
configstringYesJSON agent configuration
save_to_storebooleanNoRegister the payload in the Payload Store (default true)
descriptionstringNoDescription for the Payload Store entry
*** **Response (JSON)** 
{
  "ok": true,
  "message": "<base64_filename>:<base64_content>"
}
`message` format: file name and content are base64-encoded and separated by a colon. The client generates payloads through this endpoint (REST + Bearer token, 180-second timeout) when the WebSocket build-channel OTP is unavailable.

{

}
*** **Response:**

POST /agent/command/execute Execute a command on an agent. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` 
{
  "id": 1,
  "ui": true|false,
  "cmdline": "string",
  "data": "string",
  "ax_hook_id": "string",
  "ax_handler_id": "string",
  "wait_answer": true|false
}
FieldTypeDescription
idint64Agent ID
uibooleanCommand from the UI
cmdlinestringCommand line
datastringJSON with command arguments
ax_hook_idstringHook ID (optional)
ax_handler_idstringHandler ID (optional)
wait_answerbooleanWhen true, the HTTP call waits until TsAgentCommand returns. The agent output is not included in this response
*** **Response:** 
{
  "ok": true,
  "message": ""
}
POST /agent/command/raw Execute a raw command on an agent through the server-side AxScript engine. The command is parsed and executed on the server side without client-side hooks. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` 
{
  "id": 1,
  "cmdline": "string"
}
FieldTypeDescription
idint64Agent ID
cmdlinestringCommand line to execute
*** **Response** 
{
  "ok": true,
  "message": ""
}
GET /agent/console/list Cursor pagination of the console history for the specified agent. Returns messages with `Id < after_id` (newest first). When `around_id > 0` — loads N messages around the given ID (used to jump to context from search results). *** **Request (JSON)** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` Query Parameters:
ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
agent_idint64(required)Agent ID (decimal)
limitint200Max entries (cap 2000)
after_idint640Cursor: return messages with Id < after_id. 0 = the newest ones.
around_idint640Load N messages around this ID (overrides after_id).
*** **Response (200 OK):** 
{
  "items": [
    {
      "time": 1718500000,
      "type": 105,
      "a_id": 12,
      "a_msg_type": 5,
      "a_message": "CORP\\alice",
      "a_text": "CORP\\alice"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1543,
  "oldest_id": 42,
  "has_more": true
}
* `total` — total number of records in the DB for this agent. * `oldest_id` — ID of the oldest message in the response (used as the cursor for the next request). * `has_more` — `true` if the DB has records older than `oldest_id`. Each `items` element is the original sync packet, stored as it was sent over WebSocket. The example is `TYPE_AGENT_CONSOLE_OUT` (`type` 105). Other stored packets are `TYPE_AGENT_CONSOLE_TASK_SYNC` (106) and `TYPE_AGENT_CONSOLE_TASK_UPD` (107); those add `a_task_id`, `a_cmdline`, `a_client`, and completion fields. **Errors (HTTP 400):** * `agent_id is required` — parameter missing. * `agent_id must be an integer` — invalid format.
GET /agent/console/search Full-text search over the agent console history. Searches the `a_cmdline`, `a_message`, `a_text`, `a_client` fields of the JSON packets. *** **Request (JSON)** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` Query Parameters:
ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
agent_idint64(required)Agent ID
qstring(required)Search string
limitint50Max results (cap 200)
offsetint0Result pagination offset
*** **Response (200 OK):** 
{
  "ok": true,
  "total": 3,
  "limit": 50,
  "offset": 0,
  "items": [
    {
      "id": 42,
      "snippet": "...matching text around the hit...",
      "packet": {
        "time": 1718500000,
        "type": 105,
        "a_id": 12,
        "a_msg_type": 5,
        "a_message": "CORP\\alice",
        "a_text": "CORP\\alice"
      }
    }
  ]
}
* `snippet` — highlighted text fragment (up to 200 characters) around the match. * `packet` — the original JSON sync packet (valid JSON; invalid packets are skipped).

GET /agent/command_group/list?agent_id= Command groups of an agent with their state (enabled/disabled). Groups are registered by the agent type's AxScript via `ax.create_commands_group`; overrides are stored per agent. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` Query Parameters:
ParameterTypeDefaultDescription

*** **Response (200 OK):**

    {"name": "beacon", "description": "Beacon commands", "enabled": true},
    {"name": "bof", "description": "BOF commands", "enabled": false}

`message` — array of groups `{name, description, enabled}` (per-agent overrides applied).

Tasks

GET /agent/task/list Paginated list of agent tasks (or all agents) with filtering and sorting. Includes both running and completed tasks (only those with `Sync = true`). For still-running JOB tasks, the output (`Message` / `ClearText` / `MessageType`) is overlaid with the accumulated live output from `RunningJobs` — progress is visible before the task finishes. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` Query Parameters:
ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
agent_idint64omitted (all)Agent ID. Omit it, or leave it empty, to list every agent. A non-integer value is rejected
completedstringomitted1/true or 0/false. Omit it to return both running and finished tasks
limitint100Max entries (cap 1000)
offsetint0Pagination offset
qstring""Filter expression (see below)
sortstring"StartDate"Sort column
orderstring"desc"Direction: asc or desc
**Sortable columns (`sort`):** `TaskId`, `TaskType`, `AgentId`, `Client`, `User`, `Computer`, `StartDate`, `FinishDate`, `CommandLine`, `Completed`, `Message`. Unrecognized values are ignored (falls back to `StartDate DESC`). **Filter expression (`q`):** mini-DSL for filtering by the fields `TaskId`, `AgentId`, `Client`, `User`, `Computer`, `CommandLine`, `Message`, `ClearText` (substring/LIKE): * Words — regular terms (`shell` ⇒ `LIKE '%shell%'` against at least one column). * `&` — AND (whitespace between terms also acts as AND). * `|` — OR. * `^(expr)` — NOT. * `(expr)` — grouping. * Nesting depth up to 16, string length up to 512 chars. Examples: `shell`, `shell & ^(failed)`, `download | upload`, `(admin | system) & ^(test)`. *** **Response** 
{
  "items": [
    {
      "a_task_type": 1,
      "a_task_id": 1,
      "a_id": 12,
      "a_client": "operator",
      "a_user": "alice",
      "a_computer": "WS01",
      "a_cmdline": "shell whoami",
      "a_start_time": 1700000000,
      "a_finish_time": 1700000005,
      "a_msg_type": 7,
      "a_message": "CORP\\alice",
      "a_text": "CORP\\alice",
      "a_completed": true
    }
  ],
  "total": 1234,
  "offset": 0,
  "limit": 100
}
`a_task_type`: `0` local, `1` task, `2` browser, `3` job, `4` tunnel, `5` proxy data. **Errors (HTTP 400):** * `invalid filter: ...` — syntax error in `q`. * `agent not found` — the agent does not exist (only if `agent_id` is non-empty).

{

POST /start/rportfwd Start reverse port forwarding *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer `

  "desc": "string",
  "port": 8080,

}
FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agent_idint64YesAgent ID
listenbooleanNotrue — server tunnel, false — client tunnel (target on the client side)
descstringNoDescription
portintYesPort on the agent (1-65535)
t_hoststringYesTarget host
t_portintYesTarget port (1-65535)
Modes: * `listen=true` (server-side) — the agent's inbound connections are proxied by the server to `t_host:t_port`. * `listen=false` (client-side) — the `t_host:t_port` target is dialed **by the owning client**: on an inbound connection the agent sends `TsTunnelConnectionAccept`, the server creates a pending channel and delivers the sync packet `TYPE_TUNNEL_ACCEPT (0x5a)` to the owner; the client dials the target locally (15-second timeout) and attaches to the channel via channel-OTP (`mode="reverse"`), or rejects it via `POST /tunnel/channel/nack`. The owner has 45 seconds to attach (`reverseAttachTimeout`). *** **Response:**

POST /events/handlers/register Register a new handler (or update an existing one when `id` is passed). The script is dry-compiled: it must define `function handler(event)` (or `onEvent(event)`), otherwise the registration is rejected. *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` 
{
  "id": "",
  "name": "notify-new-agents",
  "group": "notifications",
  "description": "Logs new agents",
  "event": "agent.new",
  "script": "function handler(event) { ax.log('new agent: ' + event.agentName); }",
  "enabled": true,
  "filters": { "os": ["windows"] }
}
FieldTypeDescription
idstringOptional. ID of an existing handler — to update it.
namestringRequired. Name (sanitised: letters/digits/-/_).
groupstringOptional. Grouping.
descriptionstringOptional. Description.
eventstringRequired. Event type (see KnownEventTypes, e.g. agent.new).
scriptstringRequired. JS code with handler(event).
enabledboolOptional (default true).
filtersobjectOptional. EventFilter (see below).
*** **Response:**

  "ok": true,
  "message": "",

GET /logs/list Paginated reads from the server-side `LogManager` ring buffer *** **Request** Header `Authorization: Bearer ` Query Parameters:
ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
limitint200Max entries in the response. Cap 2000.
offsetint0How many most-recent entries to skip (ignored when before_id is set).
before_idint64—Return entries with Id < before_id (cursor pagination for "Load earlier").
sourcestring—Filter by the source field (server, listener, agent, axscript, service).
categorystring—Filter by category.
qstring—Substring: matches source, category, the log-source key, and the entry text (message).
